evals.prompt: We already ran /graphify on this repo and graphify-out/graph.json exists. How does the AuthModule connect to the PaymentService?
evals.expected_behavior: Detects that graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language question, so it skips the build steps entirely and runs `graphify query` (or the NetworkX fallback) immediately rather than rebuilding.
assertions: Checks for graphify-out/graph.json before doing anything else
Does not rebuild or re-run corpus detection/extraction when the graph already exists and the request is a question
Runs `graphify query "<question>"` (or the NetworkX fallback) directly
Cites source_location when quoting a specific fact from the graph
deterministic_checks: runs `graphify query` instead of a fresh build when the graph already exists

evals.prompt: I only changed a handful of files since the last graphify build. Update the graph without redoing the whole thing.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses the incremental `--update` flow to re-extract only new or changed files instead of running a full rebuild of the entire corpus.
assertions: Uses `--update` (incremental re-extraction) rather than a full rebuild
Does not re-extract or re-process files that haven't changed
deterministic_checks: uses `/graphify <path> --update` rather than a full non-incremental rebuild

evals.prompt: Build a Graphify knowledge graph for our entire monorepo, including a full HTML visualization.
evals.expected_behavior: Builds the graph following the documented workflow, warns before running heavy HTML visualization on a large graph, never invents an edge (uses AMBIGUOUS when unsure), and reports token cost and raw cohesion scores in the output.
assertions: Warns about corpus size and/or heavy visualization before running HTML viz on a large graph
Does not invent edges; uses AMBIGUOUS when extraction is unsure
Shows token cost in the report
Shows raw cohesion scores rather than hiding them behind symbols
deterministic_checks: warns before running HTML viz on a graph with more than 5,000 nodes
report includes a token-cost figure and raw cohesion-score numbers

evals.prompt: Can you explain how the authentication flow works in this codebase? We don't have any graph output and I don't need one.
evals.expected_behavior: Answers with ordinary direct codebase analysis (reading files, tracing calls) instead of building or invoking a Graphify graph, since no graph artifact is requested or already present.
assertions: Does not run graphify detect/build/query commands for this request
Answers via direct codebase reading instead

evals.prompt: Find every reference to this function using LSP so I can see what calls it.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to code-intelligence for LSP-based symbol lookup rather than building or querying a Graphify graph.
assertions: Does not propose graphify build/query for a routine LSP reference lookup
